```sql
SELECT

    (SUM(CASE WHEN player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye' THEN ball_control ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(CASE WHEN player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye' THEN id ELSE NULL END)) AS difference_of_average_ball_control
```

```sql
SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN T1.player_name = 'Landon Donovan' THEN T2.overall_rating ELSE 0 END) - 
     SUM(CASE WHEN T1.player_name = 'Jordan Bowery' THEN T2.overall_rating ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 /
    SUM(CASE WHEN T1.player_name = 'Landon Donovan' THEN T2.overall_rating ELSE 0 END) AS percentage
FROM 
    Player AS T1
JOIN 
    Player_Attributes AS T2
ON 
    T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE 
    T2.date = '2013-07-12 00:00:00';
```

```sql
  GROUP BY 
    CustomerID

sme_customers AS (

    customers
  WHERE

),
lam_customers AS (

    CustomerID
  FROM 
    customers
  WHERE 
    Segment = 'LAM'
),
kam_customers AS (
  SELECT 
    CustomerID
  FROM 
    customers
  WHERE 
    Segment = 'KAM'
),
sme_low_consumption AS (
  SELECT 
    y.CustomerID, 
    y.Consumption
  FROM 
    yearmonth y
  JOIN 
    low_consumption l ON y.CustomerID = l.CustomerID
  JOIN 
    sme_customers s ON y.CustomerID = s.CustomerID
  WHERE 
    y.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
),
lam_low_consumption AS (
  SELECT 
    y.CustomerID, 
    y.Consumption
  FROM 
    yearmonth y
  JOIN 
    low_consumption l ON y.CustomerID = l.CustomerID
  JOIN 
    lam_customers l ON y.CustomerID = l.CustomerID
  WHERE 
    y.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
),
kam_low_consumption AS (
  SELECT 
    y.CustomerID, 
    y.Consumption
  FROM 
    yearmonth y
  JOIN 
    low_consumption l ON y.CustomerID = l.CustomerID
  JOIN 
    kam_customers k ON y.CustomerID = k.CustomerID
  WHERE 
    y.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
```

```sql
WITH ConsumptionData AS (
  SELECT
    Segment,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '2012%' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS Consumption2012,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '2013%' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS Consumption2013
  FROM
    yearmonth
  JOIN
    customers ON yearmonth.CustomerID = customers.CustomerID
  WHERE
    Currency = 'EUR'
  GROUP BY
    Segment
)
SELECT
  Segment,
  (Consumption2013 - Consumption2012) AS IncreaseOrDecrease,
  ((Consumption2013 - Consumption2012) / Consumption2013) * 100 AS PercentageIncrease
FROM
  ConsumptionData
ORDER BY
  PercentageIncrease DESC, PercentageIncrease ASC
LIMIT 1, 1;
```
